{"code": "import numpy as np

# Replace -999.0 with NaN in biomarker_baseline
df['biomarker_baseline'] = df['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999.0, np.nan)

# Check number of missing values in baseline
missing_baseline = df['biomarker_baseline'].isna().sum()
print(f"Number of missing biomarker_baseline values: {missing_baseline}")

# Also check if biomarker_final has any sentinel values (e.g., -999.0)
if (df['biomarker_final'] == -999.0).sum() > 0:
    print("Found -999.0 in biomarker_final. Replacing with NaN.")
    df['biomarker_final'] = df['biomarker_final'].replace(-999.0, np.nan)
else:
    print("No -999.0 values found in biomarker_final.")

# Check total missing values in both columns
total_missing = df[['biomarker_baseline', 'biomarker_final']].isna().sum().sum()
print(f"Total missing values in biomarker columns: {total_missing}")"}
